images.subject: Wheat
images.description: A close-up still-life photograph of wheat grains scattered across a dark wooden surface, with several dried wheat stalks lying horizontally across the upper portion of the image.

visual_characteristics.background: dark wooden tabletop with shallow depth of field

images.subject: Raw peanuts
images.description: A close-up photograph showing a large quantity of raw shelled peanuts with reddish-brown skins. The peanuts are densely packed and several have partially removed or damaged skins.

images.subject: Peanut processing
images.description: An industrial food-processing conveyor carrying a large quantity of processed peanuts. Peanuts are visibly falling from an elevated metal conveyor or chute onto the main conveyor belt.
images.process: conveyor-based handling and transfer of peanuts

images.subject: Rice processing
images.description: An industrial machine is dispensing a continuous stream of white rice grains into a large metal collection or conveyor tray.
images.process: mechanical discharge and collection of rice

images.subject: Peanut plant
images.description: A peanut plant has been pulled from the soil, exposing multiple peanut pods attached to its roots. Green leaves, stems, roots, soil, and underground peanut pods are visible.
images.process: peanut plant harvested from the ground

images.subject: Agricultural irrigation
images.description: A cultivated agricultural field is being irrigated by a sprinkler system. Water is spraying across rows of crops, with farmland and vegetation extending into the background.
